content_zh:
本来就知道她们在演戏的，没想到这一会子都都变了模样，真真是狼子野心，现在发现也不晚，秀雁看着自家姑娘，想着姑娘若是听见了一定会很难过的，没想到姑娘已经睁开了眼睛。
秀雁在看见姑娘睁开眼睛的瞬间，真的太想放声尖叫了，太好了姑娘醒了，姑娘竟然能看见这些狼子野心的玩意了，不过姑娘会看透还是更加没有了生存下去的欲望呢？
秀雁想出声提醒，就见姑娘打着手势让她安静，秀雁感觉姑娘有什么不同了，那一双眼眸十分的清冷，不在睁开眼睛就是肿眼皮红眼睛，或者全是泪水连连，说一句话都要掉上十滴眼泪的样子，甚至一年半载不会笑一下。
那边几个人也高兴够了，大夫人全副武装本来要走了，这会子高兴这么一大通，浑身都热开了，就脱下了外面的大氅，卢代蓉更是高兴的打算直接明抢，刚刚拉开被子，忽然间：“啊……”的一声尖叫，吓坏了两人。
卢代蓉已经伸出去的手就停在半路，并且语无伦次的道：“醒……那个慧姐……玉佩……慧姐醒……啊，慧姐你怎么醒了！”
“啊……娘慧姐醒了！”
“什么？”可以说只有秀雁为了这个消息淡定之外，其他的人都不知道如何消化这消息。
卢俊辉更是握紧了拳头，该死，就差了一步！
大夫人刚才还狂喜的脸色就好像吞了几吨的恭桶水似的，难看的要命，这小蹄子真真的不省心，早不醒晚不醒，偏偏最关键的时候醒了！
这回去怎么和老爷交代，老爷定要训斥她了，虽然大夫人在内宅很有威严，但是在卢大老爷跟前还是挺畏惧的。
卢代蓉那支要去拽玉佩的手，还尴尬的停在半路，本想心一横干脆抢过来算了，这里可是卢家，又不是叶家，祖母也不在家，谁能给这个爱哭包做主？
可是当她的手在往前伸了一截的时候，却再也无法前进了，原因自然是慧姐面无表情的看着她，尤其慧姐的眼神黝黑深邃，就那么直盯盯的看着自己，一股子凉意从后背袭来。
以往慧姐从来没有这样个干净的眼眸，干净的一滴泪都没有，每日除了哭就是哭，说不上三句话就开始哭，烦人的很，现在慧姐情绪如此的宁静让人无法适应，所以卢代蓉愣住了。
不知道为何就是无法下手，这会子凌嬷嬷缓和气氛道：“哎呦，真是老天保佑啊，祖宗保佑啊，叶表姑娘终于醒了，真的是太好了，真的太好了。”
“对对对，慧姐醒来真是太好了，真是老天保佑啊！”大夫人立刻换了另一幅舅甥情深的做派！
大少爷卢俊辉竟然夸张的眼睛含着泪光的道：“真是太好了表妹醒了，否则我会愧疚一辈子的！”
外面不少的奴婢听见了这此起彼伏的声音，本以为刚才听见四姑娘的喊声是错觉，这会子可是真的了，顿时有种表姑娘赶紧打赏银子才好的感觉。
欢喜的声音立刻传遍了小小的清花阁，不到一刻钟的时间，连卢家最角落的婆子奴才都知道昨晚闹腾一夜的叶表姑娘醒了。
还是大夫人给感动醒的，一时间夸奖大夫人的人，拍马屁的人更说大夫人是有福气的人。
而在内室之中吗，大夫人更是一下挤开卢代蓉，暗恨这孩子关键时刻不顶用，就是抢了她的玉佩，她刚醒了又知道什么？

大夫人一屁股坐在了床边，硬是挤出不自在的笑容道：“苍天啊，慧姐真的醒了太好了，这回也能和二妹夫有了交代了，真的太好了，慧姐你想吃什么，大舅母给这就吩咐厨房去做，想代蓉让她在这陪你，就连你想见的表哥大舅母都给你带来了，你还想要什么？”
慧姐盖好被子藏起玉佩冷漠的道：“这位夫人您是我舅母吗？真的很抱歉这次摔了头，请不要怪慧姐很多东西都忘了，慧姐现在只想要休息，这位夫人麻烦请您出去吧！”
这样的回答真的是太意外了，大夫人一瞬间有些尴尬，没有想到慧姐很多东西不记得了，不过很快就反应过来，摔得好啊，这样慧姐就不记得给自家多少银子和产业了，大夫人倒是难得很高兴！

content_en:
I knew they were acting in the first place, but I didn't expect that their appearance would change all of a sudden. They were really ambitious. It's not too late to find out now. Xiuyan looked at his girl, thinking that the girl would be very sad if she heard it. Unexpectedly, the girl had already opened her eyes.
The moment Xiuyan saw the girl open her eyes, she really wanted to scream loudly. It was great that the girl woke up and she could actually see these ambitious things. But will the girl see through it or will she lose her desire to survive?
Xiuyan wanted to remind her loudly, but saw the girl gesturing to keep her quiet. Xiuyan felt something was different about the girl. Her eyes were very cold. When she didn't open her eyes, her eyelids were swollen and red, or they were full of tears. She looked like she would shed ten tears every time she said a word. She didn't even smile for a year and a half.
The people over there were happy enough. The eldest lady was fully armed and was about to leave. Now she was so happy that her whole body felt warm, so she took off the big cloak outside. Lu Derong was even more happy and planned to grab it directly. Just as he pulled the quilt away, suddenly: "Ah..." screamed, frightening the two of them.
Lu Dairong's stretched out hand stopped halfway, and said incoherently: "Wake up...that Sister Hui...the jade pendant...Sister Hui wakes up...ah, Sister Hui, why are you awake!"
"Ah... Sister Nianghui is awake!"
"What?" It can be said that except for Xiuyan who was calm about the news, everyone else didn't know how to digest the news.
Lu Junhui clenched his fists even more, damn, he was just one step away!
The eldest lady's ecstatic expression just now was as if she had swallowed several tons of buckets of water. It was terribly ugly. This little hooves was really worried. She didn't wake up sooner or later, but she woke up at the most critical time!
How to explain to the master this time? The master will definitely reprimand her. Although the eldest lady is very majestic in the house, she is still quite afraid in front of Mr. Lu.
Lu Derong's hand was about to grab the jade pendant, but it stopped awkwardly halfway. I thought I might just grab it, but this was the Lu family, not the Ye family, and my grandmother wasn't at home either. Who could make the decision for this crybaby?
But when she stretched her hand forward, she could no longer move forward. The reason was naturally that Sister Hui looked at her expressionlessly, especially Sister Hui's eyes were dark and deep, staring straight at her, and a chill came from her back.
In the past, Sister Hui had never had such clean eyes, not even a drop of clean tears. She would cry every day, and she would start crying after she couldn't say more than three sentences. It was very annoying. Now, Sister Hui's mood was so peaceful that people couldn't get used to it, so Lu Dairong was stunned.
I don't know why I just couldn't do it. At this moment, Grandma Ling calmed down the atmosphere and said: "Oh, God bless me, my ancestors bless me. Miss Ye Biao finally woke up. It's really good, it's really good."
"Yes, yes, it's great that Sister Hui wakes up. God bless her!" The eldest lady immediately changed to another one of uncle-nephew love!
The eldest young master Lu Junhui exaggeratedly said with tears in his eyes: "It's great that my cousin is awake, otherwise I will feel guilty for the rest of my life!"
Many slaves outside heard the sounds one after another. They thought that the shouts they heard from the fourth girl just now were an illusion, but now it was real. They suddenly felt that the cousin girl should quickly reward them with silver.
The sound of joy immediately spread throughout the small Qinghua Pavilion. In less than a quarter of an hour, even the ladies and servants in the corner of the Lu family knew that Miss Ye Biao, who had been causing a lot of noise last night, was awake.
It was the eldest lady who was so moved that she woke up. People who praised the eldest lady for a while, and those who flattered her even said that the eldest lady was a blessed person.
And in the inner room, the eldest lady squeezed Lu Dairong away, secretly hating that this child was useless at the critical moment and just snatched her jade pendant. What did she know when she just woke up?
The eldest lady sat down on the edge of the bed, unable to squeeze outHe said with a comfortable smile: "Oh my god, it's great that Sister Hui is really awake. This time I can have an explanation with my second brother-in-law. It's really great. Sister Hui, what do you want to eat? My aunt will tell the kitchen to make it. I want Dai Rong to let her stay here with you. Even the cousin and aunt you want to see have been brought to you. What else do you want?"
Sister Hui covered herself with the quilt and hid the jade pendant and said coldly: "Madam, are you my aunt? I'm really sorry for falling my head this time. Please don't blame Sister Hui for forgetting many things. Sister Hui just wants to rest now. Madam, please please go out!"
This answer was really unexpected. The eldest lady was a little embarrassed for a moment. She didn't expect that Sister Hui wouldn't remember many things, but she quickly realized that it was a good fall, so that Sister Hui wouldn't remember how much money and property she gave to her family. The eldest lady was very happy!
